finding: Scoped physical reduction placement looked up reducer columns only in the original input, rejecting valid preceding projections and potentially overlooking an overwritten column shape.
changes: Resolve reducer column requirements backward through preceding project operators, following their expressions against the prior input.
Honor dropped columns, empty/select-all projections and own-property lookup semantics.
Use the existing admitted aggregate expression contract to validate derived columns without allocating an inferred-schema cache.
Reject non-scalar literal backing in that contract while preserving primitive, decimal and timestamp literals.

scenarios: Two chained projections, including an overwritten input column, feed correct scalar sum and grouped count snapshots under an allocation scope.
Dropped columns, binary column aliases and binary literals are rejected during placement.
All scoped execution reservations release after result consumption.

remaining: Planner/runtime scratch and other unsupported shape contracts remain under audit.
This is physical operator correctness and capability evidence, not production cloud or whole-heap validation.
